intervals.label: BULLKID detector development
intervals.note: Earliest dated BULLKID paper read (arXiv 29 Sep 2022); the name 'BULLKID-DM collaboration' appears in the May 2026 paper ('The BULLKID-DM collaboration aims to provide such an experiment'); formation date unpublished.
intervals.quote: We introduce BULLKID, an innovative phonon detector consisting of an array of dices acting as particle absorbers sensed by multiplexed Kinetic Inductance Detectors.

name: BULLKID-DM Collaboration
notes: external.inspire_experiment is null: INSPIRE was not consulted (its rate budget belongs to the supervised importer).

summary.plain: The Italian, French, German, Mexican and other physicists developing BULLKID, a silicon detector array read out by superconducting sensors, and the BULLKID-DM dark matter experiment based on it.
summary.technical: Collaboration of Sapienza University and INFN Roma, Pisa and Ferrara, INFN LNGS and GSSI, Institut Neel (Grenoble), KIT-IPE, UNAM and TIFPA developing the BULLKID detector and the BULLKID-DM experiment (author affiliations of arXiv:2601.13766).
